description:
"Command the powers of Oblivion to send a Daedric clannfear to fight at your side. The clannfear's headbutt deals |cffffff1250|r Physical Damage, while its tail spike hits nearby enemies for |cffffff1320|r Physical Damage after |cffffff1|r second.  

Once summoned, you can activate the clannfear's special ability for |cffffff4450|r Magicka, healing you for |cffffff6437|r and the clannfear for |cffffff3218|r.

The clannfear remains until killed or unsummoned."
